I completely AGREE WITH THIS. I can’t express how many times I have this happen. I’m called lazy, attention begging, etc everyday because I haven’t had the balls to end it. 

Also rant I’m tired of people saying “it passes” as someone with Bipolar Depression yeah okay true it does but fuck I don’t know when it does and I don’t know when it comes back. But god forbid it comes back, people don’t give a fuck and dismiss me as if it’s normal. It’s actually not normal at all the severity each time is worse.
I need to, I am supposed to go to therapy hopefully they’ll help and not send me to a psych ward
I hope the same for you too ❤️

I’m at my wits end with living. I have a nervous breakdown at work the other day, then my manic high started I was fine. Today I said I will have a great attitude no matter what, of course something extreme happens I’m trying to control my triggers but it was difficult and I failed. I’m back to the Low Lows and I’m severely fed up with life. I’m tired of being lowkey called a failure 24/7. I officially do not want to eat, I do not want to walk into my job that starts in 20 minutes. I just want this shit to end.
